taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-01 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-01
Curve type: A-type (resistivity increases progressively with depth across all four layers)
Aquifer depth: 23.97 m – 28.60 m (moderately resistive weathered/fractured zone beneath the surface layer, overlying the highly resistive basal unit)
Recommendation: Target drilling through the 23.97–28.60 m interval, where the weathered/fractured zone of intermediate resistivity suggests the best groundwater potential; case off the upper 24 m of lower-resistivity overburden and terminate drilling once the sharp resistivity rise to 3560.6 ohm-m (likely competent/unweathered bedrock) is encountered, as further depth is unlikely to improve yield.
